text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: C'mon Bourbon. As I'm sure ya noticed, this park's scary for real, not just for kids.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I have noticed. I collected a
testimonial suggesting that this park 
inspired last year's party committee, so I
have updated the tasklist to include
researching it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, it was unclear who should
perform the task, as it was not
listed in the original plans. Hence,
as chief of the party committee, I
must attend to it.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Again?! Is that all you can say?! "Task
this," "task that"!

text_block_list.name: Park Staff
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, how about a group photo?
Squeeze in, smile, and you'll be
best
friends again in a flash!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Oh! Y-yes, please! Everyone, gather round!

text_block_list.name: Park Staff
text_block_list.text: Here we go! Say "cheeeese"!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, this will make such a lovely
souvenir. Tamtam, Bourbon, Rice,
Rob
Roy, and me...

text_block_list.name: Park Staff
text_block_list.text: Yep, you six look great!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Six?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I see. The inclusion of a "ghost" makes
commemorative photos scary. A photo
area in a fixed, riggable location... We
could use that
technique at our party.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...No more!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Rice?! Riiice!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Th-this ride's brand new this year!
Isn't it
nice to sit down and chat as
we go along?

LOveMelOVemeLOveMEloVemELovEmeL
oVEmELoveMEloVeMeLO
VEmeLoVemE.

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaah?!
Bwaaaack?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Interesting.
By restricting the ability to
flee, you can impose a
greater sense of
terror.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
All right, how's everyone doing? Anyone
need a break? I have drinks,
but no
chugging them, okay?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Sigh... The next spot, for sure! I'll set up a chance for Rice to talk with Bourbon...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy, is everything okay?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, um, I'm fine... Let's go to that
haunted house next!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Request: processed.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"None shall escape this manor. The exit is
veiled in shadow, and the
card key is
shrouded in mystery."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...We've been locked in.

text_block_list.name: Rob Roy & Rice
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Adding new entry to task list: solve
mystery and locate exit.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hold the phone, were ya listening? He
said "card key." We can't have
ya fryin' our
only way out!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Just leave the electromagneto-whatever
stuff to me. I'll get us outta
here in no
time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I decline. By current assessment, you are
not responsible for our current
predicament. In the event of unexpected
errors, the
committee chief is first in line to
respond.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aaagh, not the "I'll do everything alone"
speech again! Look, ya don't
gotta tough
it out—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If I may,
I'd say that escaping the haunted
house is a mission for all
five of us.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I know! How about we split up the tasks?
Rice, Bourbon, and I can
search the room
on the right.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Tamtam and Rob Roy can
investigate the room on the
left. That way,
we're bound to escape twice as fast!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Optimal workflow settings, updated.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Looks like this room's got a number
lock. I
bet the combo's hidden
somewhere in the
other room, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Know what? I'm gonna go check up on how
Team Bourbon's doing. Ya
comin' with,
Rob Roy?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Oh, no... I'll stay.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh, okay.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Rob Roy? From what I've seen,
horror's not your forte. Why'd ya
come out
to a spooky place like this?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I just... you know, um...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to give Rice a chance to speak
with Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Rice? I gave her a chance myself, and all
they talked about was the
weather.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, but I'm sure there's something
more—she just hasn't worked up
the
courage to say it yet.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I saw an article about this park's
Halloween event and how letting loose
here can bring people together. I figured
it'd be a good place for Rice to share her
inner thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
But here we are, and I still haven't
managed to set the mood...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha. I'll get 'em talkin', so don't you
worry.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You stay put here, then. I'll let 'em know
you were thinkin' about 'em.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Tamtam. I had a feeling you'd show
up. But I'm afraid you're not
getting past
me. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What?
